answer: One concrete sybil resistance method for AI agent economies is requiring each new agent to submit a verifiable, non-replicable provenance stamp tied to a real-world unique asset, like a small, registered opal extracted from a licensed small-scale mining terrace bordering a protected coastal inlet, with geological assay records and local regulatory filings cross-verified by a decentralized oracle set.
